{"metadata":{"description":"ChatGPT Subscription - a DeepSeek Harness plugin: bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota","id":"gh:1335287168","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-chatgpt-sub","slug":"songoao25/dsh-chatgpt-sub","topics":["ai-agents","awesome-dsh-plugin","chatgpt","codex","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","javascript","oauth","plugin","subscription"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"ChatGPT Subscription - a DeepSeek Harness plugin: bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and c"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"hat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# ChatGPT Subscription"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | **中文**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects your ChatGPT account through OpenAI's sign-in page and lets "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"you use the account's available ChatGPT models inside DSH. You need an account with Codex access and"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" sufficient quota. The plugin does not reject Free accounts, but sign-in alone does not establish ac"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"cess to models in DSH; availability depends on OpenAI’s plan, client and model restrictions. See Ope"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"nAI’s current plan information."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Sign in from the plugin page, then select a model under the **ChatGPT** provider. The plugin maintai"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ns the sign-in and shows account status, expiry, and **Sign in again / Unbind** actions. Available m"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"odels depend on your account and DSH's model support."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The companion Bottom Info Bar displays available quota windows and reset times. Both plugins can be "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"installed independently; ChatGPT quota display needs a valid sign-in."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Recommended: install from npm through DSH.** Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH and enter the pa"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ed: install from npm through DSH.** Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH and enter the package name:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"DSH looks the name up on npm and installs it with pnpm — no repository checkout, no build step. The "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"package has been public on npm since 2026-10-13."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"For a CLI web profile:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"If npm cannot be reached, use the repository address instead — `lib/` is committed, so that path nee"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ached, use the repository address instead — `lib/` is committed, so that path needs no build either:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Then **restart DSH**. Refreshing the page is not enough. In the desktop app, use **Plugins → Add plu"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"gin**; its profile is managed by the app and cannot be installed into through the CLI."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Local installs, Windows guidance, updating and troubleshooting: docs/INSTALL.md."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Open **Plugins → ChatGPT Subscription** and choose **Sign in with ChatGPT**. Complete authorization "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"in the browser; when the page shows **Connected**, select a ChatGPT model in the conversation model "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"picker. Allow DSH pop-ups if the authorization page does not open."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The browser confirms success only after the plugin has saved the sign-in and connected it to DSH. If"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" that fails, return to the plugin page for the error; do not share sign-in files or authorization UR"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"at fails, return to the plugin page for the error; do not share sign-in files or authorization URLs."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Sign in again** renews the binding. **Unbind** disconnects the account from this plugin. An existi"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ng Codex CLI sign-in is not automatically adopted by the plugin."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Sign-in data and updates"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Authorization and model requests communicate with official OpenAI endpoints. Sign-in tokens are save"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"d in the standard local `~/.codex/auth.json` file with owner-only permissions and synchronized into "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"DSH's credential store. Signing in can update that shared file, so it can affect which account Codex"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" CLI uses. Tokens are transmitted to OpenAI for authorized requests; they are not written to plugin "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"uses. Tokens are transmitted to OpenAI for authorized requests; they are not written to plugin logs."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Unbinding and uninstalling preserve `~/.codex/auth.json` and remove the plugin's binding and managed"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" DSH entries. The plugin refreshes sign-in automatically. Under **Version and updates**, automatic u"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"pdates (default) check npm when DSH starts, verify and replace the plugin files, then take effect af"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ter a restart. Manual mode checks without installing; installation asks for confirmation. Failed upd"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ates restore the previous files, and settings offer rollback when needed. Sign-in data is preserved."},{"id":"p24s6","text":" Local checkout and linked installs require a code update and rebuild; see docs/INSTALL.md."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Uninstall and roll back"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Remove the plugin from the desktop app's **Plugins** page, or use `dsh plugin --profile web remove d"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"sh-chatgpt-sub` for the CLI web profile, then restart DSH. Uninstalling keeps `~/.codex/auth.json` ("},{"id":"p26s3","text":"the Codex CLI's own sign-in) and removes this plugin's binding and the DSH entries it manages. To go"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" back a version instead of removing the plugin, **Version and updates** offers rollback after a fail"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ed update or while a newer build waits for a restart. Do not include sign-in files, credentials, or "},{"id":"p26s6","text":"account details in bug reports."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Languages"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The plugin includes English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portugue"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"se, French, German, Italian, Russian, Hindi and Indonesian. It follows DSH’s language by default. Ch"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"oose **Language** on this plugin’s settings page to use a different language independently; the choi"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ce is saved in this browser. Regional variants such as Spanish (Mexico) and Portuguese (Brazil) use "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"the corresponding built-in language.
